description: This file contains type definitions and functions related to managing compaction timeouts and snapshot selection within an agent context, including signals, timeout resolution, and snapshot selection logic.

methods.name: export function shouldFlagCompactionTimeout(signal: CompactionTimeoutSignal): boolean { shouldFlagCompactionTimeout
methods.description: Determines whether to flag a timeout based on the provided signal, returning true if a timeout has occurred and compaction is pending, retrying, or in flight.

methods.name: export function resolveRunTimeoutDuringCompaction(params: { resolveRunTimeoutDuringCompaction
methods.description: Decides whether to extend or abort the run timeout during a compaction process based on whether compaction is pending, retrying, in flight, and whether the grace period has already been used.

methods.name: export function resolveRunTimeoutWithCompactionGraceMs(params: { resolveRunTimeoutWithCompactionGraceMs
methods.description: Calculates the total run timeout in milliseconds by adding the run timeout and the compaction timeout durations.

methods.name: export function selectCompactionTimeoutSnapshot( selectCompactionTimeoutSnapshot
methods.description: Selects the appropriate snapshot (pre-compaction or current) based on whether a timeout occurred during compaction, returning the message snapshot, session ID, and source.
